projects.name: MVP4 — Side-Effect Triage (4 approaches)
projects.desc: Four escalation architectures over one clinical spine, toggleable: (A) red flags ruled out first, the nurse-triage standard; (B) report symptoms first, we sort them; (C) one question at a time; (D) an agent conversation in a modal — tap to answer, follow-ups only when they change the outcome, agent-written summary at the end. Built on the clinician escalation table + Schmitt-Thompson telephone-triage rules. Urgent routes to same-day care rather than promising a callback Bold can't make. D's LLM rewords questions only; the rules own every clinical decision.
